<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>false</active><api_name>x_835786_firewall.AdapterFactory</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>The AdapterFactory decides which adapter to return based on a platform type string or enum</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AdapterFactory</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AdapterFactory = Class.create();
AdapterFactory.prototype = {
    createAdapter: function(platformType) {
        switch (platformType) {
            case "PANORAMA":
                return new PanoramaAdapter();
            case "PRISMA":
                return new PrismaAdapter();
            default:
                throw "Unsupported adapter platform: " + platformType;
        }
    },

    type: "AdapterFactory"
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-10-16 14:28:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>5603ea7283a872100caa54d6feaad31a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AdapterFactory</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Firewall Interface Management Spoke" source="x_835786_firewall">3be3b9cd831472100caa54d6feaad3d5</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Firewall Interface Management Spoke">3be3b9cd831472100caa54d6feaad3d5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_5603ea7283a872100caa54d6feaad31a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-10-16 15:39:49</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
